summary:

The agent's Bash tool, decision 0053 and test_agents stay: the 2026-10-28 ruling puts the Bash removal in q24 (i44), with r32 held by the brief until then (C1).
The branch review gets its own stage list, keyed branch-review, with Read/Glob/Grep and no Bash entry. review keeps READER for the work-item reviewer. Rests on r32 and supervision r14.
The agent body reads every run, commit and change from work run's brief (supervision r154-r156) and gives run-only behaviour as findings with a test marked not run (r33). It verifies the dry-run agreement test from the suite run's output (r34). C2 is taken as reading A.
Depends on w216, which gives those runs in the brief.
The whole-suite exemption in work_items.py stays: every session with no work-item carries that worker name.
Tests broken: none (verified test_agents, the stub's allowedTools assertions and the supervision review steps).
